newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Parliament approves $14.38 bln Kuwait budget.
newsitem.headline: Parliament approves $14.38 bln Kuwait budget.

text.p: Kuwait's parliament on Tuesday approved a 4.378 billion dinar ($14.38 billion) state budget for 1997/98 with a gross deficit of 1.584 billion dinars.
The net deficit for the fiscal year which started July 1, 1997 was projected at 1.274.

Expenditure was put at 4.378 billion dinars while total revenues were projected at 3.105 billion dinars. By law, 10 percent of total income is placed in an overseas investment account -- leading to the higher deficit.

The 4.21 billion dinar 1996/97 budget carried a projected net deficit of 1.21 billion dinars and a gross deficit of 1.51 billion which was cut considerably by a rise in oil prices in 1996 of some $5 a barrel above budget projections.
Actual figures for the last fiscal year have not been released yet.
Oil revenue in the 1997/98 budget was estimated at 2.56 billion dinars.

"Oil revenue is estimated at two million barrels per day (Kuwait's OPEC quota) at $13 a barrel in line with the principle of caution when calculating oil revenue which is estimated at 2.555 billion dinars ($8.391 billion)," the financial committee said in its presentation of the draft budget to parliament.
The new budget still requires ratification by head of state, Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah.
